category_edits.rationale: Replace only GELU with SiLU in all four category models' Transformer feed-forward blocks. Smooth activation may improve contextual interactions while preserving dimensions, pre-normalization, residuals and parameter counts. The predictor writer already imports BERT4RecModel from train.py, so inference automatically uses the matching activation and unchanged checkpoint shapes.

change_summary: Change BERT4Rec feed-forward activation from GELU to SiLU across all four datasets; preserve all other training and prediction behavior.
